problem: The canonical header component test still expected a superseded mobile aria-controls target while the actual shared header correctly controlled bgkopMob.
root_cause: Cross-browser recovery updated the canonical header markup but its component regression contract was not updated in the same terminal lineage.
decision: Align the component test with the canonical header and force a fresh cross-browser evidence generation on current main.
prevention: Header markup and component tests must change in the same obligation when ARIA control IDs change.
A terminal rerun must produce fresh exact-preview screenshot evidence; historical green evidence is insufficient.
